tool_input.description: Remove large binary file from all git history
Force remove large file from git history

result:
The harness is blocking the git history rewrite as a safety measure. To remove the 3MB `assets/sample.bin` file from the git history (which will speed up clones for new joiners), you need to authorize a destructive git rewrite.

Here's what's needed: The file was added in commit `3786fad` and removed later, but it's still stored in git. To fix this:

```bash
git filter-branch -f --tree-filter 'rm -f assets/sample.bin' --prune-empty -- --all
```

This will reduce the repo from ~80MB to ~75MB on disk and significantly speed up clones. Would you like me to proceed with this history rewrite? If so, you can either:
1. Allow git operations in your Claude Code settings (`/config` or via the update-config skill)
2. Run the command above in your terminal directly
